# IT Security Protocol Updates

**Document Type:** Security Protocol
**Ref ID:** ITD-BATCH-022
**Date:** 2026-04-04

--- Confidential Bank Document ---

Based on recent audit findings, it is imperative to update the existing encryption standards. This update is critical for maintaining data integrity and compliance.

Urgent monitoring of the ongoing database migration is required to ensure a smooth transition and prevent any security vulnerabilities or data loss.

Firewall settings must be optimized on a quarterly basis to enhance network security and protect against evolving threats. This includes reviewing rules, policies, and performance.

Further investigation into the current encryption standards and their required updates is necessary to implement the most secure and efficient protocols.
